flow.text: Tap through: Sign in → trip list. Gear → Settings. ⋮ → Sign out. A card → its trip (Edinburgh is a trip shared with you; Liverpool is your own). Back arrows return; system back does the same. Dialogs close via X.

idioms.text: Idioms: one scrolling list with Now / Upcoming / Past headers (empty groups hide, so no tabs). No bottom navigation: only Trips and Settings. Booking form is a full-screen dialog. Row ⋮ opens a bottom sheet. Snackbars only for short confirmations.

states.text: Not boarded, same as the web app: "Loading…", "This trip does not exist or is not shared with you.", Rename as a text-field dialog (error "Give the trip a name"), share error "Enter an email address", Gmail return notices (green "Gmail connected as …", red "Gmail access was not granted." / "Connecting Gmail failed. Try again."), "Importing…" with a linear progress bar, the offline banner.

gaps.text: Shown as the product is, not fixed: no way to add a trip (trips come from imports and merges); booking Delete, Merge, Disconnect and Sign out have no confirmation; rows say "Car", the form says "Car rental"; "Import anyway" reports a raw outcome token; sign-in errors show raw Firebase text; a sharee never sees who owns the trip.

theme.text: Theme: Material 3 roles from the web app's zinc palette; primary zinc-900 (zinc-100 in dark), amber tertiary for warnings, red error. Geist with system fallback. Pill buttons and FAB, 12px cards, 28px sheets and dialogs. Launcher icon is adaptive: dark square background, white paper plane foreground.
